title: resolve-uses
summary: Internal lookup verb: ranks the units that declare a symbol, to decide which unit a uses clause needs
intro: Internal and not listed in --help: given a symbol name (and optionally the file that needs it), it ranks the units whose interface declares that symbol. For everyday work use find-unit, or check-unit --resolve-uses to annotate undeclared identifiers.

questions.ask: Which unit declares an identifier a unit is missing from its uses clause?

notes: internal: diagnostic behind the documented `check-unit --resolve-uses` flag; standalone hidden verb (DoResolveUses), separate from check-unit --resolve-uses.; seed: group guessed
